instructions_en: Listen to four people and match each speaker with the information that best describes them.
instructions_vi: Nghe bốn người và ghép mỗi người với thông tin phù hợp.

audio.transcript: Speaker 1: I can walk for a long time if I have a close friend with me. On my own, I usually get bored after twenty minutes. Speaker 2: My apartment is noisy in the afternoon, so I often take my laptop to a quiet café and do my work there. Speaker 3: I sold my car last year. The bus takes a little longer, but it is cheaper and I do not need to find parking. Speaker 4: I spend most weekends cycling or running in the park. I would rather be outside than in a gym.
